person_made_it: Built at noon on the day for Gordon at Pier 80 with Brennan: his plan A with the USA match, his Dog Blood history from his own ledger, his second ticket named correctly, his host named, the official Saturday set times read from the festival's own image, and today's hourly weather for that exact pier.
emcee_who_is_speaking: The pier itself, in 3D: tap a stage and it tells you who is on and who is next from your phone's clock; Darby speaks once in the 44 second gate briefing; the plan builder hands the mic to Gordon.
what_time_of_day_is_this_room: It changes with the real clock: afternoon sky over the water, sunset at 7:01, night for Robyn and Dog Blood, the Mellier idiom of one coral seed deriving teal, violet and gold overprints on a dark ground.
did_the_click_pay_me: Drag spins the pier, tap flies to a stage, star builds a plan and flags clashes, Surprise me pays out confetti, a fact from his own history or a nudge, the crane hides a laser show, weather refreshes live, the countdown ticks to the next starred set.
works_for_the_recipient: Phone first at 390 wide, one thumb, touch orbit with no library, a static riso hero and the full schedule as plain HTML when WebGL or JavaScript is missing, big type for a dark pier, and the 3D is capped in pixel ratio so it stays cool on a phone battery.
taught_me_something: The official Saturday grid runs Despacio as a room from 2:45 to 9:45, while the festival's own info page lists a separate birthday Despacio party across the street at 401 Cesar Chavez, 5 to 11 PM, on its own ticket; the page says both and tells him to ask at the gate. And the wind at Pier 80 doubles between 3 and 7 PM, which is why the layer matters for Dog Blood more than the temperature does.
told_me_the_truth: The June ticket was a payment plan and nothing in mail confirms it finished, so the page says check the AXS app before the gate; the Electric Zoo 2019 Dog Blood night is labelled as his own recollection; the Ship Tent lineup is marked from the official image and nothing is invented.
weakest: Walking minutes between rooms are my estimates from the pier's layout, not measured; if the Warehouse is farther than eight minutes from the Pier Stage, the clash flags are optimistic. No live crowd or wait time data.
